visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a wide shot of the Roman Colosseum under bright, clear daylight. A young woman with short hair, wearing a bright yellow puffer jacket and a white helmet, is seated in a light blue vintage Vespa sidecar. She raises both arms in a celebratory gesture. Behind her, a man in a blue jacket sits on the scooter. The ground is made of grey cobblestones, and other tourists are visible as blurred figures in the background. (2) The camera transitions to a handheld tracking shot following the Vespa as it navigates narrow, sunlit Roman streets. The woman remains in the sidecar, looking around with a smile. The buildings lining the street are tall, historical structures with warm-toned facades and wooden shutters. Several other scooters and cars are parked along the curbs. The lighting is natural and creates long, soft shadows. (3) A close-up shot features a middle-aged man with salt-and-pepper hair and a beard, wearing a blue jacket and a headset. He is speaking directly toward the camera, gesturing with his hands. The background is a slightly out-of-focus city street with architectural elements. (4) The scene shifts to the Trevi Fountain, where the woman in the yellow jacket and a young man in a dark jacket pose in front of the turquoise water and white marble statues. They are seen throwing a coin over their shoulders into the fountain. The area is crowded with many other tourists in the background. (5) The video cuts to an interior shot of the Pantheon, looking up at the massive dome with its central oculus. The lighting is dramatic, coming from the top opening. Later, the woman is seen back on the Vespa sidecar, riding through a tree-lined boulevard with sunlight filtering through the leaves. (6) A top-down shot shows a white table at an outdoor cafe with three large croissants and two cups of cappuccino topped with latte art. The woman’s hands are visible as she reaches for a pastry. In the final phase, the woman is back at the Colosseum, posing one last time in the sidecar as the sun begins to lower, casting a warm glow on the ancient stone structure.
